experiments.plan.help: Enter a seed, whole days from 0 to 365, an initial mode and a versioned profile. Parameters: humidity, light and randomness from 0 to 100; angle of repose from 15 to 55°; temperature from 5 to 45 °C; X/Z winds from −4 to 4 units. Omitted values receive explicit defaults in the manifest.
experiments.results.help: CSV with the initial state and daily observations; manifest with the full configuration, version and CSV SHA-256 hash. Files contain no execution dates.
experiments.terminal.help: Using the source of this same version and Node 24, save the downloaded configuration and run:
experiments.terminal.output: The output directory must be new. The command creates dados.csv and manifesto.json. To configure using arguments:
experiments.limits: One model day equals 100 ticks. Values are exploratory and are not calibrated by species. Isolated experiments use the portable arithmetic policy stdlib-f64-v1. To compare files, use the same Viveiro version, configuration and policy recorded in the manifest. The 3D terrarium and existing saves continue to use the native policy, which can produce different trajectories. No real-weather queries or server-side continuation.
